series_manifest.source_name: Food Systems 2026 organic Nordic evidence pack
series_manifest.notes: Staging register preserving all extracted indicators, source metadata, target file, import status and comparability flags. Includes Iceland Tún/TRACES, EEA historical share, 2040 policy target additions, KRAV private-label metrics and reconciled Ekomatcentrum public-procurement rows.

notes: Prices use Eurostat HICP food as the first cross-country comparable monthly backbone.
Trade mixes total-goods monthly series with Finland's ready monthly agri-food series, so trade comparability is partial.
Production contains one directly comparable oats-quantity subgroup (FI/NO/SE) and documented fallbacks for DK and IS.

Organic agriculture uses Eurostat ORG_CROPAR as primary source; 2024 coverage is partial and Iceland area/market remain needs_primary_check, though EEA historical share and TRACES current operator certificates are now staged.

Organic evidence-pack integration adds staged market, control, public kitchen, policy, selected production and selected trade series with explicit quality flags; Norway 2025 rows now use the official Landbruksdirektoratet PDF where extracted, and Sweden KRAV/Ekomatcentrum rows are included with private-label and scope-separation flags.
